segments.name: Real estate services
segments.description: A global real estate services company operating owned-brokerage and franchise businesses under iconic brands for real estate professionals and their clients.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has one operating and reportable segment, inclusive of the businesses acquired during the year, which are in the process of being integrated into the Company's core business.

revenueModel.text: The company earns a share of gross sales commissions from its owned-brokerage agents and royalties and other fees from franchisees.
revenueModel.evidence: We primarily generate revenue from our owned-brokerage business when we collect a share of the gross sales commissions that these real estate professionals earn from home sales and certain other fees, such as flat transaction commission fees.

changes.text: In January 2026, the Company completed its acquisition of Anywhere Real Estate Inc.
changes.evidence: On January 9, 2026, the Company completed its previously announced acquisition of Anywhere Real Estate Inc. ("Anywhere") pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of September 22, 2025

changes.text: In January 2025, the Company acquired the company with the exclusive worldwide right to operate the Christie's International Real Estate brand.
changes.evidence: In January 2025, the Company acquired a company with the exclusive, worldwide right to operate, franchise and license the Christie's International Real Estate brand.

changes.text: In October 2025, the Company divested its Latter & Blum Texas business.
changes.evidence: In October 2025, we divested our Latter & Blum Texas business, which reduced our total agent count by approximately 900.
